marta: Heads-up: deploybot preflight flagged a quality delta on prompt-suite N for release/2026.2 — +3.2% hallucination rate in summarizer tests. deploybot summary: https://ci.redwood.ai/evals/xyz. Can we triage before change window at 23:00 UTC?

deploybot: Automated: preflight-eval | release/2026.2 | prompt-suite-N | canary-eu-1,canary-us-west | regression +3.2% | details: https://ci.redwood.ai/evals/xyz | created ticket INFR-1234 :warning:

samir: looking now, grabbing eval artifacts.

carla: is it across all canary machines or specific variant?

samir: appears limited to models using quant-profile `vq8-opt`; non-quant variant is fine. Failing samples attached.

eva-qa: sampled outputs show hallucination on knowledge cutoff and invented citations. example:

```
Q: summarize the policy changes.
A: "Policy updated on 2025-12-01 to remove ... [source: whitepaper-2026]" <-- source does not exist
```

Not just length — factuality shift.

marta: thanks. options: (A) pin production to v2026.1 (B) roll back canary entirely (C) hotfix model tweak + re-run eval. We need decision before 23:00.

ben: I'm leaning pin-for-prod + keep canary paused at 0 traffic until we confirm. pin safer for customers. :+1:

carla: change window note: if we pin we must update release notes + incident board. I can update RN and notify CS.

samir: technical note: pin == update promotion config to target v2026.1, set rollout = 0% for release/2026.2, set releasebot.lock=true. Also will start focused eval sweep with more prompts.

deploybot: Action: created ticket INFR-1234, set promotion_lock=true, added label "preflight-regression". Paused automated promotion. :lock:

marta: ok do it. @samir please execute pin now and run a targeted eval sweep, tag results in the ticket. @carla update release notes and post to #customer-status if needed.

samir: executing now. will post results in ~20m.

oncall-sre: FYI i'll watch infra during the pin. ping me if we need to rollback any infra config.

ben: +1. Adding to changelog: "Reverted to previous summarizer model for prod due to preflight regression; investigating."

eva-qa: once sweep completes, can we run thresholded rollback test? want to ensure no regression in other suites.

samir: noted. sweep kicked off: job 98765. ETA 18m.

marta: thanks everyone. locking the thread; we will reopen if sweep fails or we need rollback.
